posts.title: Your LRU cache is working too hard
posts.description: Across 6,357 production traces, most LRU promotions did little useful work. Delaying the decision made caches faster without making them less effective.

posts.title: A paper reproducibility agent: PDF in, report out
posts.description: We turned the MLSys'26 AE agent's core into a standalone paper reproducibility agent. Give it a paper PDF; it finds the repo, installs and runs it, and adjudicates the paper's claims.

posts.title: Same open weights, prompt-cache lifetimes from seconds to a day
posts.description: Across 23 providers serving two open-weight models, prompt-cache retention ranged from under 30 seconds to more than a day. Even for the same model, the serving stack determined the cache.
